source_identity.canonical_title: Les hommes sont culturellement encouragés à se comporter comme des agresseurs sexuels

translation.canonical_title: Men are culturally encouraged to behave like sexual aggressors
translation.displayed_title: Men are culturally encouraged to behave like sexual aggressors
translation.summary: In a culture where boys are taught and encouraged to behave like sexual aggressors (no education about consent, lack of empathy toward women, social validation of aggressive behavior, virtually guaranteed impunity), it is hardly surprising that a significant proportion of them act on it. And just as a scalded cat fears cold water, it is normal after an assault to begin fearing even respectable-looking men, especially since it is not written on their foreheads. These men should set their egos aside and show empathy; they would understand that the fear they inspire, even despite themselves, does not come from nowhere.
